apps.name: HelderWeer
apps.description: Material You weer-app met verwachtingen, waarschuwingen, radar en weerdetails.
apps.changelog:
Changelog

2.3.0

- Weather map fully migrated to MapLibre with smooth panning, pinch-to-zoom, +/- controls, and fullscreen.
- RainViewer radar frames from approximately the last two hours added to a real animation timeline.
- RainViewer source tiles are limited at zoom 7 and scaled up by MapLibre above that level; Zoom Level Not Supported has therefore been removed.
- Open-Meteo 15-minute precipitation added as a clearly marked model forecast after the last measured radar frame.
- One combined timeline with play/pause for measured radar and future model precipitation.
- Quick selects for Local, Netherlands, and Europe added.

-Forecast precipitation gets a smooth intensity display from blue/green via yellow/red to purple; measured RainViewer data uses the public Universal Blue scale.

-Cloud cover, wind, temperature, and air quality retained as interactive map layers with viewport-dependent labels. - Wind animation remains active only as long as the wind layer is visible.

-Map data is loaded foreground-on-demand only and temporarily cached in memory; no new WorkManager task or background location added.

-Arrangeable home screen tiles from v2.2, widgets, notifications, alerts, favorite locations, and Dutch/English retained.

-Map source attribution adjusted: MapLibre/OpenStreetMap, RainViewer, and Open-Meteo. KNMI remains the only source for official Dutch warnings where applicable.
